mechanism: Estradiol may increase rizatriptan bioavailability through CYP3A4 inhibition and enhance serotonergic effects, while oral contraceptives/HRT can increase migraine risk and potentially potentiate vasoconstrictive effects.
action: Monitor for increased rizatriptan side effects (dizziness, chest discomfort); counsel on stroke/cardiovascular risk with estradiol use in migraines; consider alternative triptan or non-triptan migraine therapy if risk factors present.
